frontmatter.title: Why AI Applications Fail Silently Without Proper Observability
frontmatter.subheading: Monitoring, logging, and tracing AI systems beyond traditional software metrics
frontmatter.excerpt: AI applications can degrade without crashing. Learn why classical monitoring is not enough and how observability, logging, and model-aware metrics help detect silent failures in production AI systems.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
